note: Your first real Jam round (Pad under the band, A minor, 66 bpm): chord changes are excellent, 64 of 66 on time, within a few hundredths of a second. The notes that didn't fit were mostly left over from the chord before (F or C while the band was already on E, D while on Am): one hand changes a little after the other. Fix: look at the next chord during beat 4 and move both hands together. Earlier results: Pattern levels 1–2 green; E, D/Dm and Em are your slowest chords, and B♭/E♭ in G minor.

items.title: Kumzitz Jam · Pad under the band: both hands together
items.why: Same part, same 66 bpm. Goal: zero left-over notes. When the app says a note is 'still from' the old chord, that hand was late.

items.title: Two-Hand Trainer · 1 · Together
items.why: Landing both hands at the same instant, without the band, is exactly the skill behind the left-over notes. It also unlocks level 2 and then the smooth shapes.

items.title: Pattern Trainer · 5 · Open 5th
items.why: Unlocks the Right-Hand Trainer and the smooth-shapes path.
